messages.author: 8c8f0ca54c4a2459
messages.subject: Re: [D-RUG]: Histogram for frequency distribution separated by year (3years)
parts:
Hi Pedro,

You can use ggplot to make a histogram like this very easily.  The following command assumes that data is in a data frame called "data" where your columns are "Year" and "DiseaseIndex", and each row represents one observation, 

require(ggplot2)
ggplot(data, aes(x=DiseaseIndex, fill=Year)) + geom_histogram(binwidth=.5, position="dodge")

See http://www.cookbook-r.com/Graphs/Plotting_distributions_(ggplot2)/ for some more examples and variations.

Noam

messages.author: 1ebe9f0f5834d2d6
messages.subject: Re: [D-RUG]: Histogram for frequency distribution separated by year (3years)
parts:
You can do it in the R base package with axis, will that suit your needs?

for example:

plot(1:max.time, pop.size[2,], ylim=c(0, carrying.capacity[2]), type='n', las=1, bty='u', ylab='Population size', xlab='Generations since introduction', cex.lab=1.5)

lines(1:max.time, pop.size[2,], lty=1, lwd=4)

par(new=T)

plot(1:max.time, f.wolbachia[2,], ylim=c(0,1), type='n', axes=F, xlab='', ylab='')

lines(1:max.time, f.wolbachia[2,], lty=2, lwd=4)

axis(4, ylim=c(0,1), las=1)

mtext(expression(paste(italic('Wolbachia'), ' frequency')), side=4, line=3, cex=1.5)

legend('bottomright', legend=c('Population size', expression(paste(italic('Wolbachia'), ' frequency'))), lty=c(1,2), lwd=4, bty='n')


Note here that the direction of text on axis 4 can't be changed and looks like crap (to me at least).

--
